desc: The M-LOK SVG (Short Vertical Grip) is a lightweight, compact, ambidextrous grip that attaches to any M-LOK-compatible octagonal aluminum handguard or forend. The side panels feature Trapezoidal Surface Projections (TSP) texture for positive control, while the front and rear straps are serrated for additional grip. It is molded from Magpul's proprietary polymer.
